claims.claim_text: Anthropic announced upgraded Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 models, which it says show improvements in coding, reasoning and vision.
claims.excerpt: Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 generate outputs up to 30% faster than Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1.
claims.excerpt: They generate outputs up to 30% faster than Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1

claims.claim_text: Anthropic lists the price of Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
claims.excerpt: they’re available at a lower price: $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.

claims.claim_text: Fast mode for Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 is priced at $16 per million input tokens and $80 per million output tokens.
claims.excerpt: Fast mode is available for $16 per million input tokens and $80 per million output tokens.

claims.claim_text: Claude Fable 5.2 is available today on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
claims.excerpt: Claude Fable 5.2 is available today on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

claims.claim_text: Claude Mythos 5.2 is not generally available; organizations can apply for access through Anthropic's Cyber and Life Sciences Verification Programs.
claims.excerpt: Organizations pursuing beneficial applications in cybersecurity or biomedical research can apply for access to Mythos through our recently expanded Life Sciences and Cyber Verification Programs.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic reports that Fable 5.2 reaches 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0 at Xhigh effort, the highest score of any released model it tested.
claims.excerpt: At Xhigh effort, Fable 5.2 reaches 49.1%, the highest score of any released model we’ve tested.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic reports that Fable 5.2 scores 83.5 on BenchCAD 2.1 at Max effort, versus 65.3 for Opus 5.5 and 44.4 for Fable 5.1.
claims.excerpt: At Max effort, Fable 5.2 scores 83.5, ahead of Opus 5.5 (65.3) and Fable 5.1 (44.4).

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says about 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents fully formalized Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean in 30 hours with minimal human intervention.
claims.excerpt: a team of 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents fully formalized the theorem in just 30 hours, with minimal human intervention.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic assesses the risk of Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 behaving unsafely in high-stakes situations as low, as with its other recent models.
claims.excerpt: we’ve assessed the risk of these models behaving in unsafe ways in high-stakes situations to be low (as with our other recent models).
